metadata.title: Carmona-Fontaine et al. (2008, 2011) & Theveneau et al. (2010, 2013) Cranial Neural Crest Contact Inhibition of Locomotion (CIL), C3a/C3aR Co-Attraction (COA), and Sdf1/Placode Chase-and-Run Collective Migration Reference Dataset
metadata.organism: Xenopus laevis & Mus musculus (vertebrate cranial neural crest streams and epibranchial placodes)

sources.citation: Theveneau E, Steventon B, Scarpa E, Garcia S, Trepat X, Streit A, Mayor R (2013). Chase-and-run between adjacent cell populations promotes directional collective migration. Nature Cell Biology 15(7):763-772.

Carmona-Fontaine C, Matthews HK, Kuriyama S, Moreno M, Dunn GA, Parsons M, Stern CD, Mayor R (2008). Contact inhibition of locomotion in vivo controls neural crest directional migration. Nature 456(7224):957-961.

Carmona-Fontaine C, Theveneau E, Tzekou A, Tada M, Woods M, Page KM, Parsons M, Lambris JD, Mayor R (2011). Complement fragment C3a controls mutual cell attraction during collective cell migration. Developmental Cell 21(6):1026-1037.
Theveneau E, Marchant L, Kuriyama S, Gull M, Moepps B, Parsons M, Mayor R (2010). Collective chemotaxis requires contact-dependent cell polarity. Developmental Cell 19(1):39-53.
Woods ML, Carmona-Fontaine C, Barnes CP, Couzin ID, Mayor R, Page KM (2014). Directional collective cell migration emerges as a property of cell interactions. PLOS ONE 9(9):e104969.

neural_crest_specimen.species: Vertebrate embryonic cranial neural crest streams (r4, r6, r7, blue) migrating dorsoventrally toward epibranchial placodes (e1, e2, e3, orange) between pharyngeal pouches (p1, p2, p3, green)

governing_equations.section: Carmona-Fontaine et al. (2008) Nature; Carmona-Fontaine et al. (2011) Dev. Cell; Theveneau et al. (2013) Nat. Cell Biol.; Woods et al. (2014) PLOS ONE

homotypic_cil_coa_pair_force.formula: F_pair(d) = -k_CIL * max(0, 1 - d / R_CIL) + k_COA * exp(-d / l_COA)
homotypic_cil_coa_pair_force.description: Short-range N-cadherin/PCP Contact Inhibition of Locomotion (CIL) repulsion for d < R_CIL balanced by medium-range autocrine complement C3a/C3aR co-attraction (COA).

heterotypic_chase_and_run_dynamics.chase_chemotaxis_sdf1: F_chase^{NC}(x_i) = chi_Sdf1 * nabla S_{Sdf1}(x_i),  S_{Sdf1}(x) = sum_{m in PL} S_0 * exp(-||x - x_m^{PL}|| / l_Sdf1)
heterotypic_chase_and_run_dynamics.run_heterotypic_cil: F_run^{PL}(x_m) = +k_run^{PL} * sum_{i in NC, d_{im} < R_het} (1 - d_{im} / R_het) * (x_m^{PL} - x_i^{NC}) / d_{im}
heterotypic_chase_and_run_dynamics.coupled_1d_gap_ode: d(Delta)/dt = d(X_PL - X_NC)/dt = v_run(Delta) - v_chase(Delta);  steady co-migrating wave at Delta = Delta^* where v_chase(Delta^*) = v_run(Delta^*) = V_stream > 0

pharyngeal_pouch_corridor_confinement.formula: U_pouch(x, y) = sum_{p=1}^2 A_pouch * exp(-((x - x_p)^2 / (2 * sigma_x^2) + (y - y_p)^2 / (2 * sigma_y^2)))
pharyngeal_pouch_corridor_confinement.description: Semaphorin-3F / Eph-ephrin repulsive pharyngeal pouch barriers (p1, p2) segregating cranial neural crest into three parallel dorsoventral streams (r4 mandibular/hyoid, r6, r7) targeting epibranchial placodes (e1, e2, e3).

theveneau_2013_experimental_regimes.section: Theveneau et al. (2013) Nature Cell Biology 15(7):763-772 Figs. 1-6; Carmona-Fontaine et al. (2011) Dev. Cell 21(6):1026-1037 Figs. 2-5

regimes.label: Wild-Type Chase-and-Run (NC + Placode, intact CIL + C3a COA + Sdf1)
Placode Removal / Sdf1 Morpholino (chi_Sdf1 = 0, unguided CIL+COA cluster)
C3aR Morpholino / Co-Attraction Ablation (k_COA = 0, dispersive single cells)
N-cadherin / DshDep+ Blockade (k_CIL = 0, k_run = 0, chase without run)
Stationary Sdf1 Bead Control (Fixed Sdf1 source, k_run = 0 -> target arrest)
